notes.key_messages:
What candidates did well
• Candidates responded appropriately to command words and followed instructions carefully.
• Many candidates showed a good knowledge across a wide range of chemistry topics.
• Many candidates set out the calculations clearly labelling each of the steps.
• Many candidates were able to draw clear, accurate mechanisms using the correct terminology.
